# Real 40-seat review run request

This commit intentionally triggers the `push` event for `.github/workflows/qg-g3-real-40.yml` on `quorum/real-40-review-runner`.

Each seat must make a real authenticated API request or fail closed. No dry-run results, prefilled votes, or fictitious signatures count. Review outputs are evidence for inspection, not proof of universal physical protection.

Required GitHub Actions secret: `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
